Apple's launch pricing for the M4 MacBook Air was **$999 for the 13-inch** and **$1,199 for the 15-inch** in the US. Education pricing was lower. Apple's March 2025 announcement put the education prices at $899 for the 13-inch and $1,099 for the 15-inch. That announcement was a $100 cut from the earlier starting price.

Current US listings look different. Apple's store now sells the M5 MacBook Air, and the 15-inch M5 is listed from $1,299. I did not find a current new-M4 price on Apple's US store pages, so the $999 and $1,199 figures are launch prices and may be out of date.

Apple's Certified Refurbished store still lists M4 models at lower prices. Examples include a 13-inch M4 with 10-core CPU and 8-core GPU at $849 and several 13-inch and 15-inch M4 configurations at $1,019 to $1,189. Prices vary by configuration and color, and the listings change often.

content.text:
I couldn't confirm a current price for a new M4 MacBook Air. Apple's US store seems to have moved on to the M5 model, so the M4 may no longer be sold new there.

- **Launch prices (March 2025):** The 13-inch was $999 and the 15-inch was $1,199. Education pricing was $899 and $1,099. These may be out of date.
- **Current new model:** Apple's store now lists the M5 MacBook Air. The 15-inch M5 starts at $1,299.
- **Certified Refurbished M4 models:** The 13-inch M4 (10-core CPU, 8-core GPU) is listed at $849. Other 13-inch and 15-inch M4 configurations run about $1,019 to $1,189. Stock and prices change often.

The [Buy MacBook Air page](https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-air) and the [refurbished 13-inch page](https://www.apple.com/shop/refurbished/mac/13-inch-macbook-air) will show what's available now.
